item.title: Ego Disillusion
item.description:
This sketch is a meditation on meditation, or more precisely, on the absurd, relentless nature of the mind. Co-written with my friend Arthur Lemon, it captures the dissonance between the intention to cultivate stillness and the chaotic reality of inner life.

What begins as a practice of peaceful attention is quickly derailed by memory, song lyrics, sexual frustration, mortality, and whatever else the mind decides to throw in. Sam Harris, a Militant Atheist and Meditation Guru, described the experience as follows:

item.title: Guerra fredda al pistacchio
item.description:
Two Italian gelaterie open side by side in Valencia and immediately rediscover one of the oldest forces in European history: local pride so intense it can turn pistachio into artillery.

SCENA: Due gelataie adiacenti a Valencia, Spagna. I due attori stanno uno a sinistra e uno a destra del palco, fronteggiando il pubblico. Ciascuno ha un piccolo cartello di cartone con il nome della sua gelateria ("GELATERIA LARIANA" e "GELATO DE ROMA") e forse una paletta per gelato di cartone.
GIANMARIA si trova al centro del palco, al telefono (mimato).

GIANMARIA

item.title: Kañe Flood This
item.description:
Here is a comedy sketch written using (the artist formerly known as) Kanye West’s February 2025 flurry of outrageous tweets. I found those tweets knee-slappingly hilarious. Their sheer bluntness and swagger were like a clown car crashing through a hall of mirrors with the horn stuck on full blast.

Which reminded me of the president of the regional government of Valencia, who failed to act effectively during the floods of October 2024 and remains pretty grandstanding about it.

item.title: Originally from
item.description: One of the most popular first questions to ask a person is the place where they come from. It’s often done for the sake of small talk rather than some sinister categorisation, but my friend Arthur disagrees to the extent that he boycotts the question. He suspects the enquirer is less interested in the answer and more eager to slot you into a prewritten story. The following sketch, co-written with him, explores the rationale.
